notes.title: Puzzle Fest is here, get yourself a copy of Haimrik!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week, we celebrate the beauty of one of the most terrifying and scary genres ever created - [b]puzzles[/b]! Let's be honest, we've all encountered a puzzle in our lives that we were not able to solve and it still haunts us to this day.

Not today though! Today, we are going to face the puzzles and beat them all. Steam's [b]Puzzle Fest[/b] brings discounts to tons of puzzle games across the whole platform, Haimrik included, meaning you can get the game for [b]90% off until May 1st[/b].

So get to it and let us know how long did it take for you to beat it! Share your results and tag our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]social media accounts[/url].

Have fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/492180/Haimrik/

notes.title: Haimrik is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Haimrik is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Haimrik is officially out now!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25732054/7348d638d700f306767c3576acad0c13eca8f401.png[/img]


Haimrik has finally made his way to our computers/consoles and he wants you to help him on his journey! Fight the Word Warriors to save the kingdom as well solve puzzles to uncover mysteries and try not to get eaten alive by his "friend" lioness Masamba... Ever since he got his hands on the magical book and became immortal, she seems to think of him as an infinite supply of food!

Grab the game now while its 15 % off and help Haimrik save the world!
